lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 11 distinct white vertical lines are visible on the lateral torso. Spacing is non-uniform, with wider gaps between the anterior lines and narrower, more frequent spacing towards the posterior rump.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: A minor bifurcation is visible at the dorsal terminus of the 4th line from the anterior. Lines 7 and 8 converge closely near the dorsal ridge forming a near-parallel merger.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The 1st anterior line and the final 11th posterior line are abbreviated segments. The 3rd line is significantly fainter and narrower than the surrounding vertical array.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A grouping of approximately 8 high-contrast white spots is visible on the lower haunch/flank, positioned ventral to the terminal vertical lines.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: A row of three spots aligns horizontally across the mid-thigh, creating a semi-connected geometric line segment.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: The visible left horn exhibits a posterior-dorsal trajectory with a distinct lyrate twist, emerging from the skull at an upward diagonal angle.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: The high-contrast ivory-colored tip accounts for approximately 10-15% of the total visible linear length of the horn.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a white chevron between the eyes, white spots on the lower cheek, and distinct white markings on the lower distal limbs (socks).
